candidate.definition_en: A worker skilled in a particular craft, especially one requiring manual dexterity.
candidate.explanation_ar: الحرفي الماهر اللي بيشتغل بيده وعنده صنعة وموهبة خاصة، زي النجار أو الصايغ.

senses.definition_en: A worker skilled in a particular craft, especially one requiring manual dexterity.
senses.explanation_ar: الحرفي الماهر الذي يتقن عملاً أو صنعة يدوية خاصة.
examples: The table was made by a skilled craftsman.
We need a craftsman to fix this antique chair.
A true craftsman takes great pride in the quality of each handmade piece.
The table was made by a skilled craftsman.
We need a craftsman to fix this antique chair.
A true craftsman takes great pride in the quality of each handmade piece.
candidate.mnemonic: كلمة 'Craft' يعني 'حرفة' و 'Man' يعني 'رجل'.. هو رجل الحرفة الشاطر.
